text:
jasmin_procure: vendor_terra just pinged — FRA customs flagged a partial RMA on shipment AWB 123-45678901, holding 6/10 H100 units for inspection. ETA moved from 2025-06-18 to 2025-06-21.

vendor_terra: sorry for short notice. customs requested additional CE docs and a value confirmation. we can either pay a €450 brokerage expedite to clear now (air rebook) or wait for docs and clear by sea (eta +4 days). insurance premium increases ~0.6% for air.

alex_k: how urgent is that pool? do we have loaners nearby we can swap to avoid the expedite?

jasmin_procure: cluster impacted in iad1 — capacity for customer X is already at 92% GPU utilization. i can pull from loaner pool but that'll deplete staging buffer.

sara_ops: if we lose those 6 H100s for 4 days, latency SLO for batch inference routes will degrade. we need a short-term mitigation: throttle non-critical jobs and prioritize canaries.

mike_repair: if we rebook air we need vendor to cover extra freight for the DOA recon returns flow. can vendor_terra confirm if they absorb extra if it's their customs error?

vendor_terra: customs flagged mismatch between invoice and manufacturer declaration. that's on our broker — we can absorb brokerage fee if we also keep liability for return freight on DOA units. otherwise we ask for a 50/50 split. thoughts?

alex_k: 50/50 seems fair given timelines. but ops needs guarantee we won't lose SLA windows. can vendor provide an explicit expedite ETA if we do air?

vendor_terra: air expedite would clear in ~36 hours after payment, so overall ETA -> 2025-06-19 if we pay today. AWB for expedited routing: 123-45678901-AIR.

jasmin_procure: can you paste the broker contact and the exact invoice diff? procurement needs numbers to approve.

vendor_terra: broker: LuftLogistics GmbH, contact: anna.schulz@luftlog.de, phone +49 30 1234 567. invoice showed EUR 1,200 vs manufacturer value EUR 980 — customs wanted the lower doc to be reconciled. brokerage expedite fee = EUR 450, insurance delta = EUR 7.20.

ops-bot: ticket #INF-4721 created for cargo hold + expedite decision (assignee: sara_ops).

sara_ops: tagging @alex_k @jasmin_procure — if procurement approves 50/50 split and vendor signs to cover DOA return freight, ops will throttle low-priority tenants for next 48h and we proceed with expedite.

mike_repair: also need serial list for the 10 units before they clear — lab needs to pre-stage firmware and test harnesses. vendor_terra can you confirm S/N CSV?

vendor_terra: sending S/N CSV by EOD to jasmin_procure. sample rows: 
```
SN,Model,FW,Note\nH100-0001,H100,1.2.3,OK\nH100-0002,H100,1.2.3,OK\n...\n```

jasmin_procure: procurement approves EUR 225 share today (invoice to Redwood). vendor_terra to send pro forma and sign DOA freight acceptance.

vendor_terra: acknowledged. pro forma attached in thread (link: https://luftlog.example.com/proforma/INF-4721). we accept DOA freight for returned units.

alex_k: ops: once AWB updated to AIR please post the new tracking and routing — we'll start rebalancing jobs. sara_ops can you confirm which non-critical services to pause?

sara_ops: pause: nightly embeddings batch, internal eval runs, non-prod fine-tune queues. keep canaries and customer-critical realtime routes on.

jasmin_procure: jasmin_procure -> vendor_terra: i'll route payment for EUR 225 via our AP, pls confirm bank details and send invoice to ap@redwood.ai.

vendor_terra: bank details in pro forma. invoice will be sent to ap@redwood.ai now. AWB updated to 123-45678901-AIR after payment.

ops-bot: payment record attached (txn 0x9f3a). action: vendor to confirm pick-up in 8h.

mike_repair: once units land, send them directly to repair dock B2 for incoming QA. i'll allocate a bay and a tech.

vendor_terra: pickup scheduled. ETA to Redwood dock: 2025-06-19 14:30 CET. tracking: https://track.example.com/123-45678901-AIR.

alex_k: thanks all. i'll monitor capacity and we should be back to normal within 48h after arrival. please ping if broker pushes any more docs. :thumbsup:
